docstring.short_description: Make a heatmap from a matrix, dataframe, ordered triple, or 2D arrays.
docstring.long_description:
Data can be a Matrix, DataFrame, OrderedTriple, or OrderedPair.
X, Y, and Z must all be the same size when OrderedTriple is used
as the default input.

For DataFrames a heatmap will be created for columns that
contain continuous data (integers or floats).

parameters.name: default
parameters.type: OrderedPair | Matrix | Grayscale | DataFrame | Vector | OrderedTriple | Surface

parameters.name: show_scale
parameters.description: Whether to show the scale or not

parameters.name: reverse_y
parameters.description: If true, reverse the y axis

parameters.name: reverse_x
parameters.description: If true, reverse the x axis

parameters.name: color_scale
parameters.description: Sets the colorscale. The colorscale must be an array containing arrays mapping a normalized value to an rgb, rgba, hex, hsl, hsv, or named color string.
